pipeline_propagation.covers: A pipeline-created equate (the cc:1301 buildDynamicSymbol route stores equates in the local scope) attached to a constant Varnode through the public Funcdata::remapDynamicVarnode (funcdata_varnode.cc:1120-1126) then Varnode::copySymbolIfValid (varnode.cc:510-522): the markup propagates to the value-close destination constant (er_pipe_close dst_symbol=1) and is rejected for the not-close one (er_pipe_not_close dst_symbol=0, database.cc:640-659). Rugra reaches the identical state through add_equate_symbol's dynamic whole map + set_symbol_entry, proving the registry wiring connects the database-side main pipeline to copy_symbol_if_valid.

xml_decode_text_content_form.covers: EquateSymbol::decode database.cc:670-683 reads the <value> child through ATTRIB_CONTENT (element text). Rugra's add_map_sym reads the value via the attribute convention of the Rust encoder (val=...); real Ghidra XML stores it as element text, and the Decoder trait does not expose element text content, so oracle-produced XML decoding is unverified end-to-end.

varmap_build_dynamicsymbol_leg.covers: Funcdata::buildDynamicSymbol's constant leg (funcdata_varnode.cc:1301) in Rugra goes through the varmap ScopeLocal model (funcdata.rs build_dynamic_symbol), which never constructs a database::SymbolEntry nor sets a Varnode mapentry; the varmap->database bridge is untested and outside this lease's write-set.

branches.detail: database.cc:676-677 reads <value> via ATTRIB_CONTENT (element text). The Rust Decoder trait is attribute-based and Element.content is unreachable from it, so add_map_sym's equatesymbol leg reads only the val-attribute convention of the Rust encoder. Fix path: add an ATTRIB_CONTENT/content accessor to the Decoder trait + XmlDecode (marshal.rs lease), then extend add_map_sym to fall back to element text.

funcdata.rs build_dynamic_symbol's constant leg (funcdata_varnode.cc:1301) uses the varmap ScopeLocal model and attempt_dynamic_mapping sets only the MAPPED flag + a name-table entry; no database::SymbolEntry is ever attached to the Varnode, so copy_symbol_if_valid cannot see varmap-created equates. Fix path: a varmap->database bridge lease (funcdata.rs/varmap.rs write-set) that routes the constant leg through database::Scope::add_equate_symbol or attaches database SymbolEntries.
